slides.texte_overlay:
habits that make you
quietly lucky in life

saying yes to small invites

go to the coffee, the talk, the small event you'd normally skip. most lucky breaks start with a random conversation in a place you almost didn't bother to go.

talking to strangers

chat for a minute with the person next to you in a queue or a class. lucky people simply meet more people, so more chances find their way to them over time.

noticing more

lucky people notice opportunities others walk straight past. slowing down and paying attention is honestly half of what we all call good luck in the end.

knowing a bit of everything

the more you know, the more connections you can spot. 5 minutes a day learning something new gives luck far more places to land in your busy everyday life.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing a bit of everything

the more you know, the more you notice. the Sophia app turns learning into one short lesson a day, a planet or a myth, and those 5 minutes give luck more places to land.

slides.texte_overlay:
trying again

lucky people try things more often and don't take a no personally. the more times you try, the more often one of those tries quietly works out for you.
